Jules F: Dropping a tiny, copyable runbook for go-live warmups + renewal watch. Aim: AE can paste these in support chat.
Nina W: Love concise. Include a streaming smoke and the quick renewal triggers.
Raj P: Added paste-ready snippets. Will run the first smoke.
Jules F: Runbook summary: prefill -> reserve warm pool -> prime KV cache -> run two streaming smoke checks -> monitor first-72h signals -> tag renewal-risk and AE ping.
Jules F: Prefill (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"tenant_xyz","prompts":["welcome","example_q"],"limit":30}'
```
Raj P: Streaming smoke (SSE curl) to validate chunking + partial retrys:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"ping","max_tokens":48}' \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-small"
```
Nina W: Retry policy (front-end): exponential backoff + full jitter, retries=3, base_ms=300, cap_ms=25000. Escalate to async queue if >25s cumulative latency.
Jules F: Renewal-risk quick flags for AE (auto tag): sustained 5xx >3% for 30m, >=15% drop in completion rate vs baseline, repeated 429 spikes in first 72h, poor go-live survey (<=3). Tag `renewal-risk` and schedule a 15-min check.
Raj P: ops-bot started prefill job jf-721 for tenant_xyz  ETA ~90s. I'll run the streaming smoke at 10:15 PT and paste results.
ops-bot: alert rule created: TenantStreamChunkLoss for tenant_xyz (watch enabled).
Jules F: I'll make this a one-pager for AEs and include the feedback form link. TL;DR for AEs: prefill, reserve warm pool, run smoke, watch alerts, collect feedback, tag & engage. :white_check_mark:
